categories.description: Requires your response. Clients, partners, leads, personal emails needing action. Add your own partner/client names here for better classification.

Automated alerts, workflow errors, payment confirmations, invoices, bounces.
Promotional emails, cold sales emails, unsolicited newsletters, offers, discounts.
Meeting invitations, calls, Google Meet, Zoom, calendar events.
Informational, no action needed. Tool updates, subscribed newsletters, social media notifications.

parameters.content:
## Sub-Workflow Integration Point

Two executeWorkflow nodes were removed from this template:

1. **Lead Detection** — Originally detected when an incoming email was a prospect responding to outreach
2. **Proactive Email Processor** — Originally triggered an AI assistant to draft responses for known leads

These connected to a CRM/lead management system. You can add your own sub-workflows here by:
- Adding an Execute Workflow node after the Gmail Trigger
- Connecting it in parallel to the Es Spam node
- Referencing your own lead management workflow ID

The Gmail Trigger outputs the full email object which you can pass to any sub-workflow.

## AI Email Manager — Setup Guide

**Step 1:** Create 6 Gmail labels: Responder, Oportunidad, Notificacion, Marketing, Reunion, FYI

**Step 2:** Update all Label nodes with your Gmail label IDs

**Step 3:** Connect your Gmail OAuth2 and OpenAI API credentials

**Step 4:** Configure WhatsApp notifications (Evolution API, Twilio, or replace with Telegram/Slack)

**Step 5:** (Optional) Connect a Postgres/MySQL database for lead-skip logic, or remove those nodes if you don't need it

**Step 6:** Customize the 'Es Herramienta Stack' filter with YOUR tool/SaaS email senders

**Step 7:** Customize classifier categories in the 'Clasificador Email' node with your business context and partner names
